selection_policy: Fixed before acquisition and training: retain original train/validation assignments; add Hide-and-Seek and Echo captures to training; reserve Mirai 34-1 and Somfy 7-4 as fresh test sessions. Selection by published size and additional scenario/device coverage, not scores.
